title: finding(app-shell/ConditionBuilder): the hook condition editor lints at scope record but its autocomplete still advertises os / current_user / vars - roots the server never binds, so the suggestion lints green and the runtime throws
body:
Dedup keywords: `hook condition autocomplete` · `unbound scope roots` · `introspectCelScope` · `HookConditionError` · `ROW_PREDICATE_ROOTS`

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#8167 (PR objectui#9643); filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat after re-reading it against the three filing classes. ⛔ Unassigned, ungraded, and ⛔ **no `domain:*` applied** — routing is the triage seat's.

## The trap

The hook `condition` editor now lints at scope `record` (objectui#8167, ruled). Its **autocomplete still advertises the engine's whole default root list**.

Measured on the installed `@objectstack/formula`:

```
introspectScope(scope 'record').roots
  -> ["record", "previous", "input", "os", "current_user", "user", "vars"]
```

`ConditionBuilder` passes **no `roots` override**, so that whole list is what the mount offers an author.

The server binds only two of them. From objectstack `origin/main`, `packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts`:

```ts
const r = ExpressionEngine.evaluate<boolean>(expr, { record: record ?? {}, previous });
```

and an unevaluable condition **throws `HookConditionError`** two lines later — fail-loud, by objectstack#4775.

⇒ the editor offers `os.user.id` / `current_user.x` / `vars.x`; the lint stays **green**, because `@objectstack/formula`'s `SCOPE_ROOTS` accepts them at that scope; and the authored condition is then **rejected at runtime**.

## Why this is class (c) and not a style nit

「AI 写元数据会被运行时拒收或静默丢弃的陷阱」 — this is the **rejected** half, and it is reached by following the editor's own suggestion. The author is not guessing: the surface proposes a root, validates it clean, stores it, and the runtime refuses it.

⚠️ Note the boundary this does **not** cross: it is not the 「warning that steers an author toward metadata the runtime honours but makes things worse」 case that the class deliberately excludes. Here the runtime honours nothing — it throws.

## The repo has already solved this once, on the sibling surface

`ConditionalFormattingEditor` pins a truthful `ROW_PREDICATE_ROOTS` list for its own surface, and its docblock states the hazard in as many words:

> Suggesting an unbound root would author a condition that silently never matches

⇒ the fix shape exists in-tree and has a precedent; what is missing is the same treatment on the hook mount's roots forwarding.

## ⛔ Why objectui#8167 did not fix it

Out of that card's surface, and the distinction is clean: **objectui#8167 is about which SCOPE a mount lints in; this is about which ROOTS it advertises.** Folding it in would have widened a ruled card past its ruling.

⚠️ Related but deliberately separate, recorded by the same dev on objectui#8167 and ⛔ **not** part of this card: the page-block mount does not pass `slot="visibleWhen"` even though `visibleWhen` is in `celAuthoring`'s `FIELD_RULE_VERDICT_SLOTS`, because routing it there would apply the field-rule bound roots `[record, previous, parent]` to a tier that binds `record / current_user / page` — neither a subset nor a superset. `celAuthoring`'s own docblock warns against exactly that edit. Anyone widening `FIELD_RULE_VERDICT_SLOTS` should read both.

## Provenance

objectui#8167 dev report and the seat's review `5701420303`. The measurements above were taken by the dev against the installed package and objectstack `origin/main`; ⛔ this seat re-derived the `SchemaRenderer` binding half but has **not** independently re-run the `introspectScope` reading — treat that one as the dev's measurement, dated, not as a seat reading.

⛔ This seat did **not** run a dedup query for this card. Dedup words are at the top.
